mapper.select: SELECT b.*, p.project_name, sc.contract_name FROM budgets b LEFT JOIN projects p ON b.project_id = p.id LEFT JOIN subcontractor_contracts sc ON b.contract_id = sc.id WHERE b.id = #{id}
SELECT b.*, p.project_name, sc.contract_name FROM budgets b LEFT JOIN projects p ON b.project_id = p.id LEFT JOIN subcontractor_contracts sc ON b.contract_id = sc.id
SELECT b.*, p.project_name, sc.contract_name FROM budgets b LEFT JOIN projects p ON b.project_id = p.id LEFT JOIN subcontractor_contracts sc ON b.contract_id = sc.id WHERE b.project_id = #{projectId}

SELECT b.*, p.project_name, sc.contract_name FROM budgets b LEFT JOIN projects p ON b.project_id = p.id LEFT JOIN subcontractor_contracts sc ON b.contract_id = sc.id WHERE b.contract_id = #{contractId}

SELECT b.*, p.project_name, sc.contract_name FROM budgets b LEFT JOIN projects p ON b.project_id = p.id LEFT JOIN subcontractor_contracts sc ON b.contract_id = sc.id LIMIT #{pageSize} OFFSET #{offset}

SELECT b.amount AS budget_amount, COALESCE(SUM(a.amount), 0) AS used_amount, b.amount - COALESCE(SUM(a.amount), 0) AS remaining_amount, CASE WHEN b.amount > 0 THEN (COALESCE(SUM(a.amount), 0) / b.amount) * 100 ELSE 0 END AS usage_rate FROM budgets b LEFT JOIN accounts a ON (b.project_id IS NOT NULL AND a.project_id = b.project_id) OR (b.contract_id IS NOT NULL AND a.contract_id = b.contract_id) WHERE b.id = #{budgetId} AND a.type = 'expense' AND a.status = 'completed' GROUP BY b.id, b.amount
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO budgets (budget_name, amount, project_id, contract_id, start_date, end_date, status, created_at, updated_at) VALUES (#{budgetName}, #{amount}, #{projectId}, #{contractId}, #{startDate}, #{endDate}, #{status}, NOW(), NOW())
mapper.update: UPDATE budgets SET budget_name = #{budgetName}, amount = #{amount}, project_id = #{projectId}, contract_id = #{contractId}, start_date = #{startDate}, end_date = #{endDate}, status = #{status}, updated_at = NOW() WHERE id = #{id}
